page_note: This page contains NO cosmological substrate. It is a Manichaean salvation-history narrative: the passion of Jesus, his resurrection, the sending of the disciples, Paul the apostle, and the subsequent corruption of the church "in the latter time" until the righteous one of truth revealed what was hidden. Teaching purity is 0.000 — confirming the absence of substrate. Strong editorial fatigue (+12.0 apostolic, +13.2 ecclesial in second half) reflects the shift from apostolic narrative to ecclesial-polemical material about church corruption. Page is heavily damaged (85.7%). The whole sequence is editorial framework — hagiographic narrative + ecclesial reflection. Classification splits between apostolic_dialogue (savior/apostle hagiography) and manichaean_ecclesial (church-of-the-Saviour, latter-time-of-the-Church material).
